description_te: BPL మహిళలకు సంవత్సరానికి 3 ఉచిత LPG గ్యాస్ సిలిండర్లు (ప్రతి 4 నెలలకు 1). ~90 లక్షల households benefited.
description_en: 3 free LPG gas cylinders per year for BPL women (1 every 4 months). Approximately 90 lakh households benefited.

eligibility_criteria.lpg_connection: Must not have another LPG connection from any OMC in same household
eligibility_criteria.bpl_status: Urban and rural BPL households; SC/ST, PMAY-G, AAY beneficiaries eligible
excluded: Agricultural land ≥ 3 acres wet OR ≥ 10 acres dry

benefit_amount: 3 free LPG gas cylinders per year (1 every 4 months)
application_process_te:
1. Official MeeSeva website (ap.meeseva.gov.in) కి visit చేయండి
2. Deepam Gas Connection option select చేయండి
3. Form fill చేసి documents upload చేయండి
4. Submit చేయండి
5. Processing: 7-15 రోజులు
go_reference: Super Six scheme launched by TDP government 2024-25
